acceptanceCriteria: A helper in spec/support/x.rb that is called from spec/a_spec.rb and spec/b_spec.rb yields findings naming each calling example with path:line
Ambiguous helper names (defined in two support files) abstain with a named reason rather than guessing
Caller linking is bounded (files and callers) with a stated cap, covered by tests
Spec TSA-V0 requirements updated; spec-requirements-check and focused testsource/testvalidity tests pass
body: Residual from V1-1824 (PR #1141). BLOCK-NOT-CALLED reports a helper and its callers only within the same file. RSpec helpers usually live in spec/support/*.rb or shared contexts and are called from many spec files, so the vacuous examples in those other files are not reported, and the helper finding alone does not say which examples are vacuous. Expected: when the analysed set includes the support file and the calling spec files, callers in other files are linked to the helper finding, bounded and with abstention when a name is ambiguous (several helpers with the same name). Observed against PR #1141 head 19b2f18b6, 2026-10-18.
title: test-validity: link BLOCK-NOT-CALLED helpers in spec/support files to their callers in other spec files
